goalMetric: Weekly anonymous utility sessions that produce a correct result, plus the proportion that continue into a connected tool using the same context
activationMetric: First anonymous completion rate — percentage of new visitors who complete a full calculation without authentication in their first session
approvalBoundary: BUILD_AUTHORIZED by Isaac on 2026-09-09; RELEASE_ACCEPTED is reserved for post-build independent verification. Chemistry features are gated until verification gate passes.

constraints.anonymousFirst: Calculators must work without authentication. No email capture required for core results
constraints.noExitIntent: No exit-intent email capture or fake case studies anywhere in the product
constraints.noMandatoryGates: Account creation must never be required to reveal a core result
constraints.noPricingInNav: Pricing, subscription, and payment pages are retired from nav/sitemap
constraints.noSocialMarketing: Social marketing pages (Pinterest, TikTok) are not part of current launch
constraints.noBranding: Final branding, logo, and photography are deferred; existing tokens are provisional
constraints.contextTransfer: Inputs transfer between all tool stages without re-entry via local state and share URLs
constraints.formulaVersioning: Every formula output carries calculator version and dataset revision
constraints.cloudPersistenceOptional: Cloud persistence requires account creation (future slice); all core tools work without an account
constraints.chemistryVerificationGate: Chemistry engine requires deterministic specification, source manifest, independent review, hand/reference calculations, and cross-calculator fixtures before public release
constraints.contentQuality: Every published page must supply at least one of: verified working tool, editable worked calculation, useful downloadable artifact, verified reference data with provenance, or substantive synthesis of real workflow evidence
constraints.noFabrication: Do not invent traffic, revenue, conversion rates, or business performance
constraints.noUnavailableInfrastructure: Do not invent unavailable infrastructure; reference only existing project artifacts
constraints.exampleLabelling: All examples, synthetic data, and proof artifacts are explicitly labelled 'Example'
constraints.makingModeAnonymous: Making Mode timer resume works for anonymous sessions via browser Local Storage (future)
constraints.moneyNeverCrossesCurrencies: Money is never summed across currencies; all monetary values in a single calculation must share the same currency code
constraints.saleableYieldDefinition: Saleable yield excludes trim, samples, defects, and units retained for testing
constraints.markupVsMargin: Markup and gross margin are separately labeled and verified against reference cases
constraints.targetPriceAlgebraic: Target price before percentage/fixed fees is solved algebraically, not approximated by markup multiplier
constraints.eventBreakEvenCeiling: Event break-even units = ceiling of fixed event costs divided by weighted contribution per unit
constraints.noClaimedSafety: No blanket cure-completion percentage or safety declaration; 'Estimated window reached' copy is correct
constraints.disclaimerNotSubstitute: Safety disclaimers describe scope but never substitute for correct calculations
constraints.chemistryFailClosed: No real formulation output is advertised as usable or considered released until independent sources/reviewer/fixtures approve it
constraints.buildVsRelease: Missing external source, domain, legal, or asset evidence blocks publication of the affected route, not implementation behind a production-off flag
constraints.iaCleanupPrerequisite: IA cleanup must complete before any routes are exposed; dead /tools content, 404 homepage routes, and empty category pages must be resolved first
constraints.singleCanonicalRoute: One canonical /tools/<tool-slug> per shipped tool; no fake tool route should be exposed
constraints.retiredRoutes: Pricing, subscription, marketing, email/CRM, social campaign pages are retired from nav/sitemap; implementation removal is a future cleanup slice
constraints.blogDraftOnly: /blog can remain only as unlaunched/draft content, not acquisition scope; no thin SEO expansion
constraints.homepageModuleDistribution: Homepage must distribute 2,000+ words through visual modules, not text walls

capabilities.name: Homepage and tool directory
capabilities.description: Public homepage with visual module distribution (2,000+ words) and canonical all-tools catalogue

/tools is the canonical all-tools catalogue
Tool catalogue shows every actual tool with status, input→output promise, and direct action
Desktop tool catalogue is constrained; mobile stacks with no horizontal overflow
Each tool links directly to a functional /tools/<tool-slug> route
No fake tool route is exposed
Category filters match all tool categories
Connection indicators show which tools share context
No pricing, subscription, or marketing page appears in navigation or sitemap

capabilities.name: Canonical SEO architecture

sitemap.xml exists and includes all public pages only

JSON-LD structured data is present for Organization and FAQ
Public pages return HTTP 200 when accessed anonymously
Canonical URLs contain no duplicate /marketing tree

capabilities.name: Ingredient costing
capabilities.description: Calculate material cost from ingredient costs and quantities — FIRST PROOF vertical
acceptanceRows: User enters ingredient costs and quantities without authentication
System calculates material cost from quantities and entered costs
Cost per made unit and cost per saleable unit are displayed
Result carries formula revision and calculator version
Missing costs are flagged explicitly; result is labelled incomplete if inputs are missing
Calculation is deterministic: same inputs always produce the same outputs
No chemistry is involved; this is a genuinely working non-chemistry tool

capabilities.name: Waste and yield adjustment
capabilities.description: Account for waste, trim, samples, defects in batch cost
acceptanceRows: System distinguishes made units from saleable units
Saleable yield excludes trim, samples, defects, and units retained for testing
Cost per saleable unit consistently increases when saleable yield decreases

capabilities.name: Cost per made/saleable unit
capabilities.description: Separate cost per made unit and cost per saleable unit
acceptanceRows: Full batch cost, cost per made unit, and cost per saleable unit are all displayed
When saleable yield changes, cost per saleable unit updates consistently
Missing costs are flagged and the result is visibly labeled incomplete

capabilities.name: Missing-cost warnings
acceptanceRows: A result with missing costs is explicitly labeled incomplete
The incomplete result is not styled or presented as a recommendation
The specific missing inputs are listed in the result

capabilities.name: Recipe scaling
capabilities.description: Scale recipes to target batch weights proportionally — second vertical
acceptanceRows: User enters a target batch weight and sees all ingredient amounts recalculated proportionally
Scaling is proportional and mathematically correct across all ingredient types
The scaled result retains the original formula revision and source attribution
Context transfers to batch cost tool

capabilities.name: Mold volume/capacity
capabilities.description: Calculate mold capacity from volume or dimensions
acceptanceRows: User enters internal dimensions or measured water-fill volume and receives normalized target-fill volume
Planning mode returns a visibly approximate range with assumption provenance
Metric/imperial fixtures pass

capabilities.name: Craft-fair break-even
capabilities.description: Calculate break-even units for a craft fair
acceptanceRows: User enters fixed event costs and expected selling price per unit
System calculates break-even units as ceiling of fixed costs divided by weighted contribution per unit
Result is displayed with the methodology shown

capabilities.name: Chemistry verification gate
capabilities.description: Deterministic specification, source manifest, independent review, cross-calculator fixtures required before public release
acceptanceRows: Deterministic specification is documented and version-controlled with a named author
Source manifest with effective and revision dates exists and is accessible
Independent review by a named domain owner is documented with a sign-off date
Hand and reference calculations are verified against independent computation
Cross-calculator fixtures pass independently with no averaged values used to artificially satisfy checks
Differences between authoritative sources are explained and resolved, not averaged away
capabilities.note: Chemistry is a gated later journey, never first proof. No real formulation output is advertised as usable or considered released.
